_about: Labelled cases for the owner-request Stop hook (pm hook owner-request). Each case is a final reply, the open needs and actions Beads holds when the hook runs (owner: 'me' is the stopping session, 'other' another session), and the verdict the rule gives: needless when the reply asks leave for (or offers) a step agents may take without asking (work the sprint, commit, push its branch, open its PR), even when a request matches; block when the reply asks the owner for something (a decision, a review, an action or a clarification) that no open request of this session asks for; else pass: an offer or suggestion nothing waits on, and text that asks nothing (a report, a quote, the agent's plan, a question it put through AskUserQuestion). Labels come from the rule, never from model output.

cache.title: Keep the render cache on disk or in memory?
cache.description: The renderer caches parsed records. Options: disk (survives restarts, 20 MB), memory (faster, rebuilt on start). Default: disk.
